answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Rapid Fire on Nibbit first, consuming the 3 Sparks, then Kaboom! on Nibbit for 1 Energy, then Imaginary Friend for 1 Energy.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: Rapid Fire, Imaginary Friend, and Duck and Cover, trading Kaboom!'s 7 damage for 5 additional Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the additional 5 Block from Duck and Cover, so only 5 of the incoming 12 damage is blocked.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger attack intent would have moved me to Rapid Fire, Imaginary Friend, and Duck and Cover for 10 Block.
